The concept has no use that the formula retail rows on file cover.
Zoning district NCD-HAIGHT: a use of 2,500 square feet or more needs a Conditional Use, and 2,814 square feet is at or over it (Planning Code § 719, in force since before 2022-01-01).

The space is, or was last, a retail use. The use size limit does not say whether taking over an existing space is a new use of that size, and Zoning Administrator Interpretation 121.2 lets a use over the threshold change to a different use in the same floor area without a Conditional Use where the floor area does not grow significantly (Planning Code §§ 121.2(a), (b), (c); 178(e)(5), (6); 186.1(c)(4), (5), in force since before 2022-01-01).
The description does not give the floor area before the project and whether storefronts are to be merged, so whether the use size control applies is not decided.

Hours: the description gives no closing time. Hours that are not principally permitted begin at 2 a.m. or later here (P 06:00-02:00; C 02:00-06:00; Planning Code § 719, in force since before 2022-01-01); the rules did not check a closing time after 2 a.m.
No active ABC licence of a type the rules read (Types 41, 42, 47, 48, 61, 75) is on file at 1416 Haight St, so the records do not show what the space is used as now.
The rules have no Planning Code use for the concept, so it was not compared with the last use of the space and a change of use is not established.

The rules could not decide: use control of the zoning district and use size. What is missing: what kind of business it is (a bar, a restaurant, a cafe or an entertainment venue); the floor area before the project; whether storefronts are to be merged. Until that is known the rules cannot say what zoning asks of the concept: insufficient information.
